creator: Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-26 (lane B, mist_archive), 2026-11-22; operator tien-nghich-2d-26
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, custom template, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 7) then animate_character v3 per direction (keep_first_frame=false, palette passed; canvases come back 36-44 px and are centred on 32 by the build script). All four facings are separate PixelLab generations; nothing is mirrored. Diagonal direction_prompts keys are required by the tool and were filled with 'unused diagonal: ...' placeholders; no diagonal was generated.
prompt: Small scroll moth, a fat furry moth hovering low, its two broad wings are unrolled parchment scrolls with faint ink lines and bronze scroll-roller caps at the wing tips, cream-white fuzzy body, two long feathery pale antennae, big round dark eyes, a tiny bright vermilion seal mark on the thorax. 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

idle.action_description: hovers in place, the scroll wings flap slowly up and down, the body bobs gently, antennae sway, the red seal mark stays visible, no effects

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, hovers, wings flap slowly, body bobs
direction_prompts.west: facing left, hovers, wings flap slowly, body bobs
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, hovers, wings flap slowly, body bobs
direction_prompts.east: facing right, hovers, wings flap slowly, body bobs

walk.action_description: flutters forward, the scroll wings beat in a steady cycle, the body bobs up and down, antennae trail, no effects

direction_prompts.south: flies toward the viewer, wings beat, body bobs
direction_prompts.west: flies to the left, wings beat, body bobs
direction_prompts.north: flies away from the viewer, seen from behind, wings beat, body bobs
direction_prompts.east: flies to the right, wings beat, body bobs

telegraph.action_description: rises slightly and spreads both scroll wings wide open and flat, the body tilts back and the antennae stand straight up, preparing to dive, no effects

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, rises and spreads both wings wide, antennae stand up
direction_prompts.west: facing left, rises and spreads both wings wide, body tilts back, antennae stand up
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, rises and spreads both wings wide, antennae stand up
direction_prompts.east: facing right, rises and spreads both wings wide, body tilts back, antennae stand up

strike.action_description: dives forward fast with the scroll wings swept back, the body stretches long, then snaps back up and the wings spread again, no effects

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, dives toward the viewer with wings swept back, then pulls up
direction_prompts.west: facing left, dives to the left with wings swept back, then pulls up
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, dives away from the viewer with wings swept back, then pulls up
direction_prompts.east: facing right, dives to the right with wings swept back, then pulls up

strike.touchup_action_description: lunges forward in a short fast dart with both scroll wings kept open and clearly visible, the body stays upright and compact, then pulls back, never folds up, no effects

touchup_direction_prompts.west: facing left, darts forward to the left in a short lunge, both wings stay open and visible above and behind the body, the moth never folds into a thin line, stays upright
touchup_direction_prompts.east: facing right, darts forward to the right in a short lunge, both wings stay open and visible above and behind the body, the moth never folds into a thin line, stays upright

frame_count_note: The mob profile wants 3 frames for idle and telegraph but PixelLab v3 only returns even counts (min 4). Idle: 4 generated, last dropped. Telegraph: 4 generated, frame 1 dropped (kept 0, 2, 3, renumbered 0-2). The raw folder holds the kept frames only.

attempts.result: accepted: parchment-winged moth with bronze roller tips and red seal reads from the front and back

attempts.what: idle, walk, telegraph, strike x 4 directions, first take
attempts.result: all accepted; no regeneration. The retry allowance was left unused (see known_flaws, needs a human decision)

attempts.what: touch-up round (orchestrator): strike west and east regenerated once each, judged old vs new at 1x and 4x
attempts.result: both new takes shipped: the old frames crumpled into a diagonal dive shape; the new ones keep a compact whole-body silhouette with wing masses visible (west reads as a folded wing pair, east as a crescent). Modest improvement; the edge-on view still shows little of the scroll wings. Previous takes superseded.

known_flaws: needs a human decision: west and east are narrow edge-on slivers (the wings are seen from the side), so the scroll-wing identity reads only in south and north
the spec's pale antenna feathers merge with the cream body at 1x
cream and parchment colours dominate, so contrast against light floor tiles is low (the outline carries the silhouette)
strike west and east (touch-up takes) are compact folded-wing silhouettes, not the open scroll wings of south and north; they read as a moth but less specifically
